definitions: German-style shandy (drink of beer mixed with lemonade).

blocks.text: Radler is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: F. David Radler, Canadian executive and close associate of Conrad Black
Josef Karl Rädler (1844–1917), Austrians porcelain painter
Antonie Rädler (1899–1991), Marian religious visionary who founded the Maria vom Sieg shrine in Wigratzbad

blocks.text: Shandy is beer mixed with lemonade, resulting in a lower ABV for the finished drink. Shandies are popular in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and the Caribbean. In the UK, they are usually ordered as either "bitter shandy" or "lager shandy".
